videos.title: Everything's recording everybody. What now? | The Vergecast
videos.description:
Meta just shipped a pair of smart glasses with no camera — a change that both David and The Verge's Victoria Song are excited about. But these glasses, like the new product from Amazon Bee and seemingly everything else now, are still ready and willing to record the world around you at all times. What do we do in a world where everything, everywhere, might be recording? And can tech companies figure out a way to make us feel better about it?

videos.description:

videos.title: First look at Apple Home Collection
videos.description:
Apple’s new Home Collection features six devices developed with LG and Schneider Electric: three security cameras and a video doorbell that work with Apple’s HomeKit Secure Video, along with a UWB-enabled smart lock and two smart thermostats. The devices don’t have a release date yet, but when they launch, Apple promises a seamless setup process and integration with its new HomeView smart display. What do you think? Do these make you want to get started with the smart home?
